featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are considering this institute for JEE preparation, look beyond the advertisements and headline ranks.

At the time of admission, most of us asked the wrong question. We focused on top percentiles and a few success stories, which may not be relevant. Aakash contribution and quality will be visible in below....

The real questions should be:

How many students appeared in total?
How many scored below the 90 percentile?

That gives you the real picture.

The quality of education does not match the expectations set during enrollment.

Teachers are changed frequently, reportedly due to salary-related issues. This lack of stability directly impacts continuity in teaching and seriously affects students preparation.
There is no consistent academic mentoring or structured guidance. Strong follow-up is visible until all installments are paid. After that, the engagement and accountability noticeably decline.

If I had to make the decision again, this institute would be at the bottom of my list. Pls learn from other mistakes, instead of you repeating one....
